title: 第211章 宇宙星海舰队对战第210章 联邦舰队星空战火
content_zh:
第211章宇宙星海，舰队对战
这也意味着，在魔动熔炉里燃烧的并不是地精们自认为的元素能量，而是虚空世界的混沌能量。
不愧是建立金陵分部庞大基业的枭雄，说话间霸气侧漏，下面的人都为之倾倒，不敢多言，纷纷点头附和。
但是透过虬结的巨树枝杈和繁密的树叶，隐约能够察觉一股深沉的黑影在森林里流动，始终跟随在他们的身下。
他一直以为，形影丝的金光是在提醒他与齐青山的距离越来越近，所以在两人汇合之后自然光芒越盛，但事实上，就如同洛川自己一样，齐青山的形影丝也是佩戴在右手腕的。
郝仁微微吃惊，没想到妖道手里竟然还有这种好东西，不用施法就能直接只用。出于好奇郝仁往葫芦里看了一眼，结果看到数不清的恶鬼在里面嚎叫着相互厮杀。
如果苍蓝真的像宗老说的那般没有眼球，那就证明宗老说的是真的，如果苍蓝有眼睛，那宗老他们必然在撒谎。
“其实，我也很好奇，旁人都传我已经死了，你是怎么知道我还活着的？”苍蓝并没有嘲笑秦枫的意思，反而是见秦枫面露尴尬，转移了话题。
“没办法，现在我已经想明白了，当当打工人没什么不好。”灰雾君叹息道。
猎魔会被曝光的当晚，媒体圈还没来得及公布新闻，消息已经是不胫而走。
尽管他们要找的人还活着，但这些士兵们心中却没有任何欣喜，只有彻底的恐惧在意识中蔓延。
“好的，不过你身体不好，要少喝点。”凌楚楚也知道今天丈夫高兴，也就放开了，要平时他可是绝对不让叶秋喝酒的。
“我昨天一直不让他出去，他会不会乘着大家都睡着了，就偷跑了呢。”如妃说出了自己的担心。
“怎么想反抗，还是乖乖的等着接下来的节目吧，给我上，往死了打”李云看着挣扎的李浩狠狠的说道，那样子不杀了李浩决不收兵。
是的，就是他，裴君浩，那个对自己无尽嘲讽的裴少，那个将自己的尊严踩在脚下的裴少，舍他其谁？
高建武巴不得这些盟友都先冲上去和隋军消耗兵力，自然便同意了他的要求。于是，朴永正便领着两万大军跟了上来。却不料正好遇到达隆等人败退下来。
“我知道你会下台！但是我要的，就是你下台！”叶夫格尼娅神秘的笑道。
白洛汐重新躺回床上，这个山庄也不是什么可以安生的地方，郭飞羽的霸道，孔翎雨的刁难，定是一天不得安宁，离开，离开又能去哪里呢，又可以去哪里呢。白洛汐想着想着便睡着了。
第211章宇宙星海，舰队对战
此时，周楚浑然不知道这儿已经发生了的一切，他和叶秋谈完之后，就又回去喝酒，一对老少不再说那么多的话，倒是放开了肚皮，狠命灌酒。

“那是什么？你想象中的生物？还是某种上古生物？还是刚出生的刺岩巨兽？”宿弈完全表示自己想象不能。
李笑笑和古仪在厨房，偷偷看着杨乐凡的表演，李笑笑觉得他打架的姿势帅呆了，芳心怡动，如果他没有岳悦那该多好，她就可以明目张胆的喜欢他，可是没有如果，她只能默默的将自己的心思埋在心底。
但此刻已经晚了，赵云带领的余下精兵从侧面两翼杀入，而他自己，则是凭借着夜照玉狮卓绝的速度跑到了鲜卑大军的退路之上，一人一骑、横枪胸前。
牧清被这一拳砸得后退两大步，他感觉胸腔内天翻地覆，气血翻腾，好在他内功深厚，几个调息之后，气血顺畅，完好如初。
这时候马力带着那假装成左玉德家人的二十多名随从急匆匆的往张猛的那船上奔去，张猛也让人搭上了踏板，欣然看着众人上了船。
虽然何平只是护卫长的身份，但他的影响力和地位，哪怕军长、师长都望尘莫及。
此时刘福通有一种莫名的自豪感，因为他终于看到了“红巾军”给了百姓幸福。
黄忠领兵直袭鲜卑大军，广袤的草原上，数万铁骑隆隆奔跑，声势骇人。
“不痛了，有了婉儿给我揉一揉就不痛了，已经好了。”韩林儿笑着说道，也是能够更好的将自己的这样一种最为不一样的心情表现出来了。
金国士兵放箭太过突然，依河村的几位老者根本没有任何防备，一时间，数箭穿刺，血如泉涌，纷纷中箭落水，一命呜呼。
就在易尘等着董志华被扶起来的时候，枪声再次响起，让易尘有些意外的是，这枪并不是向着他们这边打过来的，而是那两名选手中的一人，似乎发现了那名独狼选手，直接开枪去打他了。
而且他们也说不清楚，总不能说他们是为了去找那些剿灭山贼的“贼人”而被人家杀了吧？
方羽大吃一惊。这个身材魁梧的刀疤男看似粗鲁愚钝，身手却这般敏捷。
护士一见情况不好控制，赶紧报告院长。院长沉吟一下，立即向110求助。公安局的民警迅速出动二十名治安警察，将在过道里等待的所有不相干的人全都轰了出去，并且拉起了警戒线。
“也只能这样了，大家能活下来真是不容易。这么大的事都过去了，现在总算安稳了。”方东淡淡笑了笑，看着底下的人，愣愣的陷入沉思。

Chapter 211: Space Star Sea, Fleet Battle
This also means that what is burning in the magic furnace is not the elemental energy that the goblins think they are, but the chaotic energy of the void world.
He was worthy of being the tycoon who established the Jinling branch's huge foundation. His words were domineering and all the people below were attracted by him. They didn't dare to say anything and nodded in agreement.
But through the giant knotted branches and dense leaves, one could vaguely detect a deep black shadow flowing in the forest, always following them.
He always thought that the golden light of the Xingying Silk was a reminder that he and Qi Qingshan were getting closer and closer, so the light naturally became stronger after the two met, but in fact, just like Luo Chuan himself, Qi Qingshan's Xingying Silk was also worn on his right wrist.
Hao Ren was slightly surprised. He didn't expect that Demon Dao had such a good thing in his hand. He could use it directly without casting a spell. Out of curiosity, Hao Ren took a look inside the gourd and saw countless evil ghosts howling and fighting each other inside.
If Canglan really has no eyeballs as Mr. Zong said, then it proves that what Mr. Zong said is true. If Canglan has eyes, then Mr. Zong and the others must be lying.
"Actually, I'm also curious. Others say I'm dead. How do you know I'm still alive?" Cang Lan didn't mean to laugh at Qin Feng. Instead, she saw Qin Feng's expression of embarrassment and changed the subject.
"I can't help it. Now I have figured it out. There is nothing wrong with working as a worker." Lord Gray Mist sighed.
The night the Demon Hunt was exposed, before the media circle had time to announce the news, the news had already spread like wildfire.
Although the man they were looking for was still alive, there was no joy in the hearts of these soldiers, only utter fear spreading in their consciousness.
"Okay, but you are not in good health, so you should drink less." Ling Chuchu also knew that her husband was happy today, so she let go. Normally, he would never let Ye Qiu drink.
"I kept him from going out yesterday. Could he have sneaked away while everyone was asleep?" Rufei expressed her worries.
"Why do you want to resist? Just wait for the next show. Come on, beat me to death." Li Yun looked at the struggling Li Hao and said fiercely. He would not withdraw his troops until Li Hao was killed.
Yes, it was him, Pei Junhao, the young master who mocked him endlessly, the young master who trampled his own dignity under his feet, who else could he be?
Gao Jianwu wished that these allies would rush forward and consume their forces with the Sui army, so he naturally agreed to his request. So Pu Yongzheng followed with an army of 20,000 people. Unexpectedly, they encountered Dalong and others retreating in defeat.
"I know you will step down! But what I want is for you to step down!" Yevgenya smiled mysteriously.
Bai Luoxi lay back on the bed. This villa was not a place where she could live peacefully. Guo Feiyu's tyranny and Kong Lingyu's making things difficult would definitely make her restless for a day. If she left, where could she go? Where could she go? Bai Luoxi fell asleep after thinking about it.
Chapter 211: Space Star Sea, Fleet Battle
At this time, Zhou Chu had no idea what had happened here. After he finished talking to Ye Qiu, he went back to drink. The old and young couple no longer talked so much, but let go and drank hard.
"What is that? The creature in your imagination? Or some kind of ancient creature? Or the newly born giant thorny rock beast?" Su Yi said that he couldn't imagine it.
Li Xiaoxiao and Gu Yi were in the kitchen, secretly watching Yang Lefan's performance. Li Xiaoxiao felt that his fighting posture was so handsome, and her heart was moved. It would be great if he didn't have Yue Yue, so she could openly like him, but without if, she could only bury her thoughts silently in her heart.
But it was too late now. The remaining elite soldiers led by Zhao Yun rushed in from the sides, and he himself, relying on the extraordinary speed of the Night Shine Jade Lion, ran to the retreat of the Xianbei army, one person at a time.A horse, a gun across the chest.
Mu Qing was hit by the punch and took two big steps back. He felt the world inside his chest was turned upside down and his energy and blood were churning. Fortunately, he had deep internal energy. After a few breath adjustments, his energy and blood were smooth and intact as before.
At this time, Ma Li led more than 20 followers who pretended to be Zuo Yude's family members to rush to Zhang Meng's boat. Zhang Meng also asked people to get on the pedal and happily watched everyone get on the boat.
Although He Ping is only the captain of the guard, his influence and status are beyond the reach of even army commanders and division commanders.
At this time, Liu Futong felt an inexplicable sense of pride, because he finally saw that the "Red Scarf Army" brought happiness to the people.
Huang Zhong led his troops to directly attack the Xianbei army. On the vast grassland, tens of thousands of cavalry rumbled and roared with terrifying momentum.
"It doesn't hurt anymore. With Wan'er rubbing it for me, it won't hurt anymore. It's already healed." Han Lin'er said with a smile, and he was able to better express his most different mood.
The Jin soldiers fired their arrows so suddenly that several old men in Yihe Village were completely unprepared. For a moment, several arrows were pierced, and blood gushed out. They all fell into the water and died.
Just as Yi Chen was waiting for Dong Zhihua to be helped up, gunfire rang out again. To Yi Chen's surprise, the gun was not fired towards them, but one of the two players, who seemed to have discovered the lone wolf player and shot him directly.
And they couldn't explain clearly. They couldn't say that they were killed because they were looking for the "thieves" who were killing the bandits, right?
Fang Yu was shocked. This burly scarred man looks rough and dull, but he is so agile.
When the nurse saw that the situation was out of control, she quickly reported it to the director. The dean pondered for a moment and immediately called 110 for help. The police from the Public Security Bureau quickly dispatched 20 security policemen, kicked out all the irrelevant people waiting in the corridor, and set up a cordon.
"That's all we can do. It's not easy for everyone to survive. Such a big thing is over, and we are finally stable now." Fang Dong smiled lightly, looked at the people below, and fell into deep thought.
